??? quote "Dialogue"

    - Sit, *Player*. I have had a long morning of chieftains telling me that everything is well. You have walked our roads. I would like to hear it from someone with no family pride to guard.
    - You walk the ridges with Skarra's people now. Good. Tell me what you see out there, not what you think the Old One wants to hear. That is all I ask of you.
    - The ridges hold, and they hold because you walked them. The Uskari cannot keep that up alone; I knew it, and now I have heard it said aloud. The far slopes are next, *Player*.
    - The drum sounds whole again, and every family heard it. Now the springs fail beyond the slopes. I need your eyes in the Withered Reach as much as I needed them on the ridges.
    - The council said it aloud at last: the patrols are thin, and all four families will share the watch. I have closed many councils. That is the first one I will remember. You told the truth when it was asked of you, *Player*.
    - What is on your mind?
        - *Choice:* Who are you?
        - *Choice:* Why ask me, and not one of the families?
        - *Choice:* How is the town?
        - *Choice:* Goodbye.
    - I am Hask, born an Uskari. I led my family nine years before the four families chose me Old One, the night after Old One Varra was mourned. I gave up the Uskari that same night, as custom asks.
    - Old One is a title, not an age; Ahvi likes to remind me I am one of the youngest the songs name. I try to listen more than I talk, and when I do talk, to say it once.
    - Because you belong to none of the four families, and you are no stranger to this kingdom either. A Kragvar will tell me the walls are fine. An Uskari will tell me the patrols are enough. You have no family's pride to protect.
    - Every season the red dots on Skarra's map creep closer, and every season the families say in council that all is in hand. Pride is a fine thing in a hunter. In a council it can get people killed.
    - Kragvar masons walk the bridge with Uskari bows beside them, and Tolmach herders tell the watch where the goats stray. It is not easy for proud people to ask each other for help. They are learning.
    - Walk carefully, *Player*. And come back and tell me.
